We propose a phased, low-risk implementation that mirrors the delivery pace we have demonstrated on comparable deployments: hospital IT programs completed in 15–33 months depending on scope and sites (15 months [CAP-042], 19 months [CAP-006], 28 months [CAP-018], 33 months [CAP-030]). For Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s four tertiary-care hospitals, we will run one design/build stream and a controlled, wave-based rollout stream to achieve early go-lives while protecting clinical continuity.

Indicative timeline (from Contract Effective Date; mobilization begins within 2 weeks):
1) Mobilization & governance (Weeks 1–4): project charter, integrated master schedule, site readiness checks, security and change-control setup (ISO 27001-certified organization) [CO-PROFILE].
2) Discovery & solution design (Months 1–3): current-state workflows (OPD/IPD, EMR, LIS/RIS, pharmacy/inventory, billing/insurance), integration inventory, data profiling for legacy records.
3) Build, configuration & interoperability (Months 2–8): module configuration, HL7 v2.x/FHIR R4 interface development and testing, central data warehouse/dashboards foundation.
4) Data migration (Months 4–10): structured extraction, cleansing, validation/reconciliation cycles, and mock migrations prior to cutover.
5) SIT/UAT, security, DR rehearsal (Months 7–11): end-to-end testing, role-based access/audit verification, and DR/RTO rehearsal ahead of production.
6) Training & go-live in waves (Months 9–15): structured end-user/admin training for ~1,200 staff, super-user model, and phased site go-lives with hypercare.
7) Stabilization & optimization (Months 15–18): KPI tuning, dashboard adoption, post-go-live fixes.

Post-implementation support & maintenance (36 months): 24/7 help desk and SLA-based support, plus preventive maintenance on O&M contracts [CO-PROFILE]. Our library does not yet evidence CMMI Level 5; we will address this mandatory requirement through an accredited CMMI L5-certified delivery partner for the software development scope, while TechnoCore provides overall program management with PMP-certified project managers [CO-PROFILE].
